title: Role card
description: A concrete reusable team role (ADR-0006). A card extends exactly one archetype and may add responsibilities, domain knowledge, skills, capabilities, outputs and advisory use_when guidance, or narrow permissions. It has no field that can grant authority: unknown keys are rejected.

use_when.description: Advisory guidance for Lead/Planner role selection. Never triggers dispatch.

skills.description: Skills a run of this card is told to load, unless a skill's description excludes the task. Each names one AEW ships, by id; any other reports unavailable

optional_skills.description: Skills a run may load when its task matches (listed by the harness's skill tool, by id; fit, not a grant: ADR-0006 amendment 2026-11-05). A name also in skills counts as skills

outputs.description: Named refinements of the archetype's evidence kind

restrict.description: Narrowing only; each list must be a subset of what the archetype allows
